burstBenefit.label: Burst Anemo DMG bonus
burstBenefit.reason: Her Burst gives its Anemo DMG Bonus to party members inside its field after it lands, a buff meant for the team, and her own Skill hits are counted with it only when she stays in the field.

c6Crit.label: Constellation 6 Anemo CRIT DMG
c6Crit.reason: A Constellation 6 bonus that comes with her Burst's Anemo buff, a buff meant for the team; it needs that switch as well.
